sentiment: The silicon we carve, the children we harm, the star we watch — all of it presses toward something we haven't earned yet.

stories.title: AMD acquires Taalas to boost inference performance by etching models in silicon
stories.summary: AMD's acquisition of Taalas signals a shift toward physical AI infrastructure — models embedded directly into silicon for faster, specialized inference.

stories.title: New Mexico court orders Meta to pay $567m over harms to children's mental health
stories.summary: A court found Meta knowingly designed features harmful to minors, surfacing questions about what technology companies owe the people they shape.

stories.title: Scientists discover Kelvin-Helmholtz Instability on the surface of the Sun
stories.summary: The NSF's Inouye Solar Telescope caught a hidden solar process in act — plasma instabilities rippling across our star's surface, ancient and indifferent.
